charts.title: HD 207496 b: orbits around HD 207496
charts.description: The orbits of HD 207496's planets in this map from above, to scale, with HD 207496 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Barros et al. 2023 (2023A&A...673A...4B), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname BARROS_ET_AL__2023): P 6.441008 d
